decision_rule: Offline source-sealed comparison of every original completion assertion and same-attempt end receipt only. Reconciled-inconclusive requires all explicit predicates and retained receipt rc75; original verdict remains inconclusive, historical outer environment unrecorded, no independent execution custody, no replay or promotion. Synthetic publisher smoke is separate and does not inspect original evidence.
notes: Model-free one-pass comparator; expected useful execution well under 300 seconds. 300 seconds is a reservation cap including scheduler startup/cleanup, never a runtime floor: no sleeps, retries, repeated dummy operations or padding. If publisher rejects short useful work, preserve offline packet instead of replaying inference.
